locked_formulas.bordered_response: A_t=H+tPi; L_t=A_t+rho*kappa*kappa^T; g=H*kappa; D_t=det(L_t); N_t=D_t*g^T L_t^(-1)g; Phi_s(t)=log(D_t(D_0+sN_0)/(D_0(D_t+sN_t)))
locked_formulas.ground_block: H=Q_+-mu I=[[a,b^T],[b,D]] in kappa plus W; D=B_u+(u-mu)I; z=D^(-1)b; x=kappa-Wz
locked_formulas.high_cross: S_M=tr(Pi*adj(H))/c; R=I-Pi; S_M-k00=E-2*kappa^T*R*(x-kappa); the sign before the high cross is minus
locked_formulas.minor_decomposition: S=partial_t det(H+t Pi)|_0=tr(adj(H)Pi); R_pm=partial_t det(H+t(kappa+-Pi*kappa)(...)^T)|_0; E=k00+S/c-(R_plus-R_minus)/(2c)
locked_formulas.odd_reconstruction: O=Q_--mu I; O*Dmode*x=-(delta x)*beta; det(O)=delta(adj(H)e0)=c*(delta x)*(e0^T x)
locked_formulas.odd_sign_gate: x_D=Dmode*kappa; s_q=Dmode*(Q_+-qI)kappa-<eta,kappa>*beta; Q_--uI>0 iff A_q+dI>0 and a_q+d-c_q^T(A_q+dI)^(-1)c_q>0
locked_formulas.projective_energy: E=||Pi_M(kappa-x)||^2=<z,K_M z> with K_M=W^T Pi_(M,+) W
